ex.s: While many visitors have never been to a farm at all, _____52_____ a sunflower farm, the unique setting allows them to _____53_____ the city for a while, breathe in the fresh air, gain a newfound _____54_____ for agriculture, and maybe even _____55_____ with their farming roots and what they may have taken for granted for too long.
ex.t: 虽然许多游客从未去过农场，____即使是向日葵农场，这个独特的环境让他们能够暂时____逃离城市，呼吸新鲜空气，重新发现对农业的____热爱，甚至可能____与自己的农耕根源以及那些长期被视为理所当然的事物重新建立联系。

ex.s: I breathed a huge sigh of relief: I had expected sadness, maybe even doubt, but Dad was already looking to the future.
ex.t: 我如释重负地长叹一口气：我本以为会看到悲伤，甚至怀疑，但爸爸已经在期待……

ex.s: Or maybe you end up switching your attention away from novels, and discover the history of romantic poets in England.
ex.t: 或者你可能最终把注意力从小说上转移开，发现了英国浪漫派诗人的历史。

ex.s: Dad said she was probably lonely, and that I ought to sit and listen and nod my head and smile, and maybe she’d work it out of her system.
ex.t: 爸爸说她可能是太孤独了，我应该坐下来倾听，点头微笑，并且……

ex.s: Maybe you won’t.” In an instant, a woman raced into my house and left happily with the vase.
ex.t: "也许你不会。"转眼间，一个女人冲进我家，拿着花瓶高兴地离开了。

ex.s: Maybe that feeling comes from growing up in South Africa, where the phrase “there are children starving in Africa” was more of an uncomfortable reminder of fact than a prayer at dinner time.
ex.t: 也许那种感觉来自在南非长大的经历，那里有"还有孩子在挨饿"的说法……

ex.s: Maybe this morning you debated whether to get up or stay in bed slightly ____14____ (long).
ex.t: 也许今天早上你还在犹豫是起床还是稍微____14____（long）多赖一会儿。

ex.s: “There is no wrong answer,” she said, “I want to know your opinion, Addie.” Hesitantly, I said, “Maybe… both.”
ex.t: "没有错误答案，"她说，"我想知道你的看法，艾迪。"我犹豫地说："也许……"

ex.s: With the right combination of animals and plants, he figured, maybe he could clean up waste the way nature did.
ex.t: 他想，通过正确的动植物组合，也许他能像大自然那样清理废物。

ex.s: Maybe it is because the combination of fresh air, smooth movement and exercise.
ex.t: 也许是因为新鲜空气、平稳运动和锻炼的结合。

ex.s: Maybe you say “go,” or turn on a certain song, or whatever. ____20____.
ex.t: 也许你说"走"，或者放一首特定的歌，或者其他什么。____20____。

ex.s: Maybe it’s an unreasonable fear.
ex.t: 也许这是一种不合理的恐惧。

ex.s: If a customer is rude or difficult, just think "Maybe she’s had a row with her husband.
ex.t: 如果顾客粗鲁或难缠，就想"也许她和丈夫吵架了。

ex.s: Anger is a particularly strong feeling and maybe people think that they have reasons to feel angry.
ex.t: 愤怒是一种特别强烈的情感，也许人们认为自己有理由感到愤怒。

ex.s: Maybe there'll be traffic jams in the air.
ex.t: 也许未来空中也会有交通堵塞。

ex.s: Maybe I'll fa in love with stinky tofu-someday.
ex.t: 也许有一天我会爱上臭豆腐。

ex.s: Maybe you can recognise your own fridge here!
ex.t: 也许你在这里能认出你自己的冰箱！

ex.s: Maybe they’re from our school.
ex.t: 也许他们来自我们学校。

ex.s: Watch surfers who catch the waves- and maybe even give it a go yourself!
ex.t: 看冲浪者乘浪而行——也许甚至可以去试一试！

defs.def: （赞同并补充信息）或许，也许，可能

ex.s: Maybe the first plant just made a cry of pain or was sending a message to its own branches, and so, in effect, was talking to itself.
ex.t: 也许第一株植物只是发出了痛苦的呼喊，或者是在向自己的枝条传递信息，因此实际上是在自言自语。
